sources.name: DEX Screener
sources.note: Exact-pool lookups in batches of up to 30: 107 requests between 2026-11-14 17:13:08 UTC and 2026-11-14 17:13:50 UTC. 1,387 pools returned a matching Uniswap v4 row with a liquidity or volume figure; pools it did not return, or returned without one, are unresolved, not zero. This snapshot asked about 2,928 of the 9,083 pools the collector knows: the pools that answered in the last 72 hours and the pools first seen in the last 72 hours every time, the others in turn (answered 72 hours to 7 days ago: every 3 hours; answered longer ago: every 6 hours; never answered: every 12 hours). The 412 pools GeckoTerminal priced that answered in the last 72 hours are asked about here every 3 hours, and GeckoTerminal is asked about the ones not priced here first in each run, as many as its requests allow. A pool that was not asked is unchecked in this snapshot, not zero. Does not index: X Layer, Zora.
